acceptance_criteria.description: find_duplicate_transaction_ids returns every transaction_id whose transaction shares the same account_id, merchant, and amount_cents key with at least one other transaction.
The returned transaction IDs preserve the original input order across multiple and interleaved duplicate groups.
The first transaction in each duplicate group is included along with later matching transactions.
Duplicate detection uses only account_id, merchant, and amount_cents, and does not treat matching transaction_id values as duplicates by themselves.
The implementation avoids the performance regression by using a linear number of duplicate-key computations on large inputs.
The fix is limited to the duplicate transaction regression and does not change unrelated AgentLoop behavior or repository structure.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Review changed files after implementation; expected primary code file is tests/test_loop/duplicate_transactions.py.
